stem: Why did Coubertin want the Olympic Games to be successful?

options.label: F
options.text: He believed sporting events would entertain people from different countries.

options.label: G
options.text: He wanted to increase the popularity of a committee he served on.

options.label: H
options.text: He hoped the Games would inspire young people to become athletes.

options.label: J
options.text: He viewed the Games as a way to promote peace among countries.
